units: <cite ref="Niddah 56a:75">Nidd. 56ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כַּבִּיד ולא בדיק</he> (= <he>כַּבְּדִי</he>) I swept (the alley) but did not search (for unclean objects).

senses.gloss: to be swept. Ib. 56ᵇ גומה לא מתכבדא a cavity is not swept (the broom does not strike it).

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 17:25">Targ. Prov. XVII, 25</cite> ed. Lag. (ed. Ven. <he>מכביר</he>, Ms. <he>מככיר</he>, h. text <he>כעס</he>).
